Multi English · 6th Grade · Theme 3

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece uses a special program on her phone to learn words. She downloaded it last week. It gives her short exercises every day. It is a language-learning ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) application

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece uses a special program on her phone to learn words. She downloaded it last week. It gives her short exercises every day.” Bu tarif “application” kelimesine uyar; application = uygulama. Diğer şıklar: satellite (uydu), screen (ekran), password (şifre).

2

Mert could not open any websites yesterday. His computer did not connect to the Internet. The same computer works normally today. Yesterday, he had a ______ problem.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) connection

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert could not open any websites yesterday. His computer did not connect to the Internet. The same computer works normally today.” Bu tarif “connection” kelimesine uyar; connection = bağlantı. Diğer şıklar: screen time (ekran süresi), privacy (gizlilik, mahremiyet), podcast (sesli yayın).

3

Selin received three emails this morning. She found them in the section for incoming mail. She usually checks this section after breakfast. She opened her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) inbox

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin received three emails this morning. She found them in the section for incoming mail. She usually checks this section after breakfast.” Bu tarif “inbox” kelimesine uyar; inbox = gelen kutusu. Diğer şıklar: screen (ekran), preview (ön izleme), password (şifre).

4

Bora created a secret code for his account yesterday. He uses it whenever he signs in. He never shares it with other people. This code is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) password

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora created a secret code for his account yesterday. He uses it whenever he signs in. He never shares it with other people.” Bu tarif “password” kelimesine uyar; password = şifre. Diğer şıklar: post (gönderi), comment (yorum), message (mesaj).

5

Duru recorded a science talk last month. People listen to the recording online, but there is no video. She creates a new episode every week. Her audio series is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) podcast

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru recorded a science talk last month. People listen to the recording online, but there is no video. She creates a new episode every week.” Bu tarif “podcast” kelimesine uyar; podcast = sesli yayın. Diğer şıklar: vlog (video günlük (vlog)), video call (görüntülü arama), digital story (dijital hikâye).

6

Arda sent his project file from his computer to the school website yesterday. His teacher can now open it online. Students use the same website for their projects. Arda needed to ______ his file.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) upload

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda sent his project file from his computer to the school website yesterday. His teacher can now open it online. Students use the same website for their projects.” Bu tarif “upload” kelimesine uyar; upload = yüklemek. Diğer şıklar: preview (ön izleme), edit (düzenlemek), trace (iz sürmek, takip etmek).

7

Elif wrote a digital story yesterday. She removed an extra sentence and corrected some mistakes before sharing it. She always checks her work carefully. She needed to ______ the story.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) edit

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif wrote a digital story yesterday. She removed an extra sentence and corrected some mistakes before sharing it. She always checks her work carefully.” Bu tarif “edit” kelimesine uyar; edit = düzenlemek. Diğer şıklar: share (paylaşmak), trace (iz sürmek, takip etmek), upload (yüklemek).

8

Can wanted to see his video before posting it. He watched a version that nobody else could see yet. He usually checks videos this way. He opened the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) preview

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can wanted to see his video before posting it. He watched a version that nobody else could see yet. He usually checks videos this way.” Bu tarif “preview” kelimesine uyar; preview = ön izleme. Diğer şıklar: password (şifre), satellite (uydu), inbox (gelen kutusu).

9

Nehir's phone displayed several alerts yesterday. One announced a new message, and another announced a lesson. These alerts usually appear at the top of her screen. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) notifications

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir's phone displayed several alerts yesterday. One announced a new message, and another announced a lesson. These alerts usually appear at the top of her screen.” Bu tarif “notifications” kelimesine uyar; notifications = bildirimler. Diğer şıklar: passwords (şifreler), devices (cihazlar), podcasts (sesli yayınlar).

10

Emir wrote a short note to his friend yesterday. He sent it through a phone application. His friend read the words and replied. Emir sent a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir wrote a short note to his friend yesterday. He sent it through a phone application. His friend read the words and replied.” Bu tarif “message” kelimesine uyar; message = mesaj. Diğer şıklar: password (şifre), satellite (uydu), screen (ekran).

11

Sena saw her grandmother on her phone yesterday. They talked and watched each other's faces at the same time. They usually communicate this way on Sundays. They had a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) video call

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena saw her grandmother on her phone yesterday. They talked and watched each other's faces at the same time. They usually communicate this way on Sundays.” Bu tarif “video call” kelimesine uyar; video call = görüntülü arama. Diğer şıklar: comment (yorum), post (gönderi), podcast (sesli yayın).

12

Baran spent four hours using his tablet yesterday. He checked a report that counted these hours. The report measures the time he spends looking at a screen. It shows his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) screen time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran spent four hours using his tablet yesterday. He checked a report that counted these hours. The report measures the time he spends looking at a screen.” Bu tarif “screen time” kelimesine uyar; screen time = ekran süresi. Diğer şıklar: privacy (gizlilik, mahremiyet), connection (bağlantı), password (şifre).

13

İpek's online lesson stopped suddenly yesterday. The sound and picture disappeared when the Internet link ended. The class continued after the link returned. There was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) disconnection

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek's online lesson stopped suddenly yesterday. The sound and picture disappeared when the Internet link ended. The class continued after the link returned.” Bu tarif “disconnection” kelimesine uyar; disconnection = bağlantı kopması. Diğer şıklar: preview (ön izleme), podcast (sesli yayın), notification (bildirim).

14

Tolga could not use a new online service yesterday. He called a number for advice and explained the problem. The staff gave him instructions. He contacted a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) helpline

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga could not use a new online service yesterday. He called a number for advice and explained the problem. The staff gave him instructions.” Bu tarif “helpline” kelimesine uyar; helpline = yardım hattı. Diğer şıklar: vlog (video günlük (vlog)), screen (ekran), satellite (uydu).

15

Eylül did not go to school during her trip last week. She joined her classes through the Internet instead. Her teachers use online lessons for students away from school. This is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) remote learning

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül did not go to school during her trip last week. She joined her classes through the Internet instead. Her teachers use online lessons for students away from school.” Bu tarif “remote learning” kelimesine uyar; remote learning = uzaktan eğitim. Diğer şıklar: digital addiction (dijital bağımlılık), screen time (ekran süresi), social distance (sosyal mesafe).

16

Ozan waited for his exam result yesterday. He worried that he did not pass and found it hard to relax. He usually feels this way before important results. He felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) anxious

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan waited for his exam result yesterday. He worried that he did not pass and found it hard to relax. He usually feels this way before important results.” Bu tarif “anxious” kelimesine uyar; anxious = endişeli. Diğer şıklar: mindful (bilinçli, dikkatli), calm (sakin), happy (mutlu).

17

Cemre lost her favourite notebook yesterday. She felt unhappy and did not enjoy the break. She usually feels better after talking to a friend. Yesterday, she felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) sad

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre lost her favourite notebook yesterday. She felt unhappy and did not enjoy the break. She usually feels better after talking to a friend.” Bu tarif “sad” kelimesine uyar; sad = üzgün. Diğer şıklar: angry (kızgın), calm (sakin), happy (mutlu).

18

Yusuf received an invitation to his best friend's party yesterday. He smiled and told his family the good news. He enjoys spending time with that friend. The invitation made him ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) happy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf received an invitation to his best friend's party yesterday. He smiled and told his family the good news. He enjoys spending time with that friend.” Bu tarif “happy” kelimesine uyar; happy = mutlu. Diğer şıklar: angry (kızgın), anxious (endişeli), isolated (yalnız, soyutlanmış).

19

Melis found her missing cat yesterday. She no longer worried about its safety. The worry disappeared when she saw it at home. She felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) relief

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis found her missing cat yesterday. She no longer worried about its safety. The worry disappeared when she saw it at home.” Bu tarif “relief” kelimesine uyar; relief = rahatlama. Diğer şıklar: tension (gerginlik), fear (korku), anger (öfke).

20

Aras heard a loud noise in an empty room last night. He thought something dangerous was inside. His hands shook, and he did not want to enter. He felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) fear

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras heard a loud noise in an empty room last night. He thought something dangerous was inside. His hands shook, and he did not want to enter.” Bu tarif “fear” kelimesine uyar; fear = korku. Diğer şıklar: amusement (eğlence), relief (rahatlama), awareness (farkındalık).

21

Sıla took part in a difficult discussion yesterday. She spoke slowly and did not shout, even when others disagreed. She usually controls her feelings well. She stayed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) calm

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla took part in a difficult discussion yesterday. She spoke slowly and did not shout, even when others disagreed. She usually controls her feelings well.” Bu tarif “calm” kelimesine uyar; calm = sakin. Diğer şıklar: angry (kızgın), anxious (endişeli), aggressive (saldırgan).

22

Gökçe worked on a project until very late yesterday. She did not sleep enough and felt that she had no energy this morning. She normally sleeps earlier. Today, she complains of ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) tiredness

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe worked on a project until very late yesterday. She did not sleep enough and felt that she had no energy this morning. She normally sleeps earlier.” Bu tarif “tiredness” kelimesine uyar; tiredness = yorgunluk. Diğer şıklar: amazement (hayret, şaşkınlık), anger (öfke), amusement (eğlence).

23

Defne followed the same pattern every school morning last term. She got up, ate breakfast and walked to school at fixed times. She still follows this daily pattern. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) routine

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne followed the same pattern every school morning last term. She got up, ate breakfast and walked to school at fixed times. She still follows this daily pattern.” Bu tarif “routine” kelimesine uyar; routine = günlük düzen. Diğer şıklar: injury (yaralanma), invention (icat), preference (tercih).

24

Kerem walked, cycled and played games in the park last weekend. He did not spend the whole day sitting. He enjoys a lifestyle with plenty of movement. His lifestyle is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) active

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem walked, cycled and played games in the park last weekend. He did not spend the whole day sitting. He enjoys a lifestyle with plenty of movement.” Bu tarif “active” kelimesine uyar; active = aktif, hareketli. Diğer şıklar: lazy (tembel), unhealthy (sağlıksız), dependent (bağımlı).

25

Buse prepared her bag and completed her project without help yesterday. She usually organises her own work. She does not need someone to do every task for her. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) independent

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse prepared her bag and completed her project without help yesterday. She usually organises her own work. She does not need someone to do every task for her.” Bu tarif “independent” kelimesine uyar; independent = bağımsız. Diğer şıklar: isolated (yalnız, soyutlanmış), aggressive (saldırgan), dependent (bağımlı).

Vocabulary Test 1 · Sonuç
0/ 100 puan
✔ Doğru: 0✘ Yanlış: 0○ Boş: 0

Her soru 4 puan. Yanlış ya da boş bir soruya tıkla; o soruya gidip doğrusunu ve Türkçe çözümünü gör.

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Deniz watched a film that made him laugh last night. It included silly situations and amusing characters. He usually chooses this type of film when he wants fun. He watched a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) comedy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz watched a film that made him laugh last night. It included silly situations and amusing characters. He usually chooses this type of film when he wants fun.” Bu tarif “comedy” kelimesine uyar; comedy = komedi. Diğer şıklar: thriller (gerilim filmi), documentary (belgesel), drama (dram).

2

İdil watched a film about real animals yesterday. It gave facts about their lives and included footage from nature. She enjoys learning real information through films. She watched a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) documentary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil watched a film about real animals yesterday. It gave facts about their lives and included footage from nature. She enjoys learning real information through films.” Bu tarif “documentary” kelimesine uyar; documentary = belgesel. Diğer şıklar: thriller (gerilim filmi), comedy (komedi), animation (animasyon).

3

Onur watched a film with a dangerous mystery last night. He felt nervous and wanted to know what happened next. The film created tension rather than laughter. It was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) thriller

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur watched a film with a dangerous mystery last night. He felt nervous and wanted to know what happened next. The film created tension rather than laughter.” Bu tarif “thriller” kelimesine uyar; thriller = gerilim filmi. Diğer şıklar: comedy (komedi), documentary (belgesel), animation (animasyon).

4

Zeynep watched a film about space travel yesterday. The story included imaginary planets and advanced machines. She enjoys stories that use scientific ideas about possible worlds. Her favourite genre is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) sci-fi

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep watched a film about space travel yesterday. The story included imaginary planets and advanced machines. She enjoys stories that use scientific ideas about possible worlds.” Bu tarif “sci-fi” kelimesine uyar; sci-fi = bilim kurgu. Diğer şıklar: drama (dram), documentary (belgesel), comedy (komedi).

5

Arda chose a film with drawn characters last weekend. The characters moved, spoke and lived in an imaginary town. He usually likes films made with drawings or computer-created images. He watched an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) animation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda chose a film with drawn characters last weekend. The characters moved, spoke and lived in an imaginary town. He usually likes films made with drawings or computer-created images.” Bu tarif “animation” kelimesine uyar; animation = animasyon. Diğer şıklar: drama (dram), documentary (belgesel), thriller (gerilim filmi).

6

Mina wrote the dialogue for a school film last month. She also described what the characters did in each scene. She enjoys writing stories for the screen. She was the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) screenwriter

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina wrote the dialogue for a school film last month. She also described what the characters did in each scene. She enjoys writing stories for the screen.” Bu tarif “screenwriter” kelimesine uyar; screenwriter = senarist. Diğer şıklar: actor (erkek oyuncu), actress (kadın oyuncu), director (yönetmen).

7

Ali guided the actors during the school film project yesterday. He decided how they performed each scene. His job is to guide the creative work of making a film. He was the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) director

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali guided the actors during the school film project yesterday. He decided how they performed each scene. His job is to guide the creative work of making a film.” Bu tarif “director” kelimesine uyar; director = yönetmen. Diğer şıklar: actor (erkek oyuncu), screenwriter (senarist), calligrapher (hattat).

8

Pelin read a document before acting in the school play. It showed her words and described her actions. Actors use this document to learn their parts. She read the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) script

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin read a document before acting in the school play. It showed her words and described her actions. Actors use this document to learn their parts.” Bu tarif “script” kelimesine uyar; script = senaryo. Diğer şıklar: portrait (portre), genre (tür), cast (oyuncu kadrosu).

9

Efe and his classmates practised their play yesterday. They repeated the scenes before the public performance. They usually practise several times before a show. Yesterday's practice was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) rehearsal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe and his classmates practised their play yesterday. They repeated the scenes before the public performance. They usually practise several times before a show.” Bu tarif “rehearsal” kelimesine uyar; rehearsal = prova. Diğer şıklar: festival (festival), screening (gösterim), portrait (portre).

10

Derya watched a foreign film yesterday. She did not understand the spoken language, but she read translated words at the bottom of the screen. These written words helped her follow the story. They were ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) subtitles

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya watched a foreign film yesterday. She did not understand the spoken language, but she read translated words at the bottom of the screen. These written words helped her follow the story.” Bu tarif “subtitles” kelimesine uyar; subtitles = altyazı. Diğer şıklar: stunts (dublör sahneleri), notifications (bildirimler), sound effects (ses efektleri).

11

Berk added the noise of rain and thunder to a video yesterday. Nobody spoke during that part. The extra sounds made the scene more realistic. He added ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) sound effects

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk added the noise of rain and thunder to a video yesterday. Nobody spoke during that part. The extra sounds made the scene more realistic.” Bu tarif “sound effects” kelimesine uyar; sound effects = ses efektleri. Diğer şıklar: stunts (dublör sahneleri), portraits (portreler), subtitles (altyazı).

12

Sena looked at a list of performers before a film yesterday. The list included every actor and actress in the film. It did not list the cameras or the locations. It showed the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) cast

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena looked at a list of performers before a film yesterday. The list included every actor and actress in the film. It did not list the cameras or the locations.” Bu tarif “cast” kelimesine uyar; cast = oyuncu kadrosu. Diğer şıklar: storyline (olay örgüsü), genre (tür), script (senaryo).

13

Burak watched a film about a family journey last night. After the film, he explained how the events connected from the beginning to the end. He enjoys discussing the order and development of events. He described the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) storyline

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak watched a film about a family journey last night. After the film, he explained how the events connected from the beginning to the end. He enjoys discussing the order and development of events.” Bu tarif “storyline” kelimesine uyar; storyline = olay örgüsü. Diğer şıklar: cast (oyuncu kadrosu), rehearsal (prova), genre (tür).

14

Eda saw a painting of a woman's face in a gallery yesterday. The artist showed her eyes, expression and shoulders carefully. Eda likes paintings of individual people. This painting was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) portrait

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda saw a painting of a woman's face in a gallery yesterday. The artist showed her eyes, expression and shoulders carefully. Eda likes paintings of individual people.” Bu tarif “portrait” kelimesine uyar; portrait = portre. Diğer şıklar: script (senaryo), documentary (belgesel), scene (sahne).

15

Tuna visited a building with old objects last weekend. He saw ancient tools, pottery and historical displays. People go there to learn about the past. He visited a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) museum

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna visited a building with old objects last weekend. He saw ancient tools, pottery and historical displays. People go there to learn about the past.” Bu tarif “museum” kelimesine uyar; museum = müze. Diğer şıklar: theatre (tiyatro), cinema (sinema), café (kafe).

16

Cem watched a film in a park last night. There was a large screen outside, and the audience sat under the stars. People enjoy films there in warm weather. It was an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) open-air cinema

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem watched a film in a park last night. There was a large screen outside, and the audience sat under the stars. People enjoy films there in warm weather.” Bu tarif “open-air cinema” kelimesine uyar; open-air cinema = açık hava sineması. Diğer şıklar: museum (müze), art gallery (sanat galerisi), Fine Arts University (Güzel Sanatlar Üniversitesi).

17

Aylin told the truth about a broken classroom window yesterday. She did not blame someone else or invent an excuse. Her teacher values truthfulness. Aylin showed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) honesty

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin told the truth about a broken classroom window yesterday. She did not blame someone else or invent an excuse. Her teacher values truthfulness.” Bu tarif “honesty” kelimesine uyar; honesty = dürüstlük. Diğer şıklar: creativity (yaratıcılık), bias (önyargı), privacy (gizlilik, mahremiyet).

18

Eren did not post his friend's personal photos yesterday. He asked for permission instead. His friend controls who sees those photos. Eren respected his friend's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) privacy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren did not post his friend's personal photos yesterday. He asked for permission instead. His friend controls who sees those photos.” Bu tarif “privacy” kelimesine uyar; privacy = gizlilik, mahremiyet. Diğer şıklar: creativity (yaratıcılık), performance (performans, gösteri), cooperation (iş birliği).

19

Nehir gave her old storybooks to a school library last week. She did not ask for money. She often gives useful things to people who need them. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) donate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir gave her old storybooks to a school library last week. She did not ask for money. She often gives useful things to people who need them.” Bu tarif “donate” kelimesine uyar; donate = bağış yapmak. Diğer şıklar: consult (danışmak), notice (fark etmek), obey (uymak, itaat etmek).

20

Baran completed the task his group assigned to him yesterday. He did not leave it for someone else. He always takes his duties seriously. He showed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) responsibility

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran completed the task his group assigned to him yesterday. He did not leave it for someone else. He always takes his duties seriously.” Bu tarif “responsibility” kelimesine uyar; responsibility = sorumluluk. Diğer şıklar: bias (önyargı), tension (gerginlik), amusement (eğlence).

21

İpek and her classmates built a model together last week. They divided the work and helped one another. They achieved more by working as a team. Their project showed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) cooperation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek and her classmates built a model together last week. They divided the work and helped one another. They achieved more by working as a team.” Bu tarif “cooperation” kelimesine uyar; cooperation = iş birliği. Diğer şıklar: privacy (gizlilik, mahremiyet), addiction (bağımlılık), bias (önyargı).

22

Tolga gave each player an equal turn yesterday. He used the same rules for everyone and did not favour his friends. He usually treats people equally. His decision was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) fair

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga gave each player an equal turn yesterday. He used the same rules for everyone and did not favour his friends. He usually treats people equally.” Bu tarif “fair” kelimesine uyar; fair = adil. Diğer şıklar: unfair (adaletsiz), biased (önyargılı, taraflı), harmful (zararlı).

23

Eylül asked her teacher for advice about an online problem yesterday. She did not make a decision before getting help. She often asks a trusted adult when she is unsure. She chose to ______ her teacher.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) consult

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül asked her teacher for advice about an online problem yesterday. She did not make a decision before getting help. She often asks a trusted adult when she is unsure.” Bu tarif “consult” kelimesine uyar; consult = danışmak. Diğer şıklar: obey (uymak, itaat etmek), donate (bağış yapmak), preserve (korumak).

24

Ozan followed the library rules yesterday. He kept quiet and returned his books on time. He usually respects instructions. He tries to ______ the rules.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) obey

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan followed the library rules yesterday. He kept quiet and returned his books on time. He usually respects instructions.” Bu tarif “obey” kelimesine uyar; obey = uymak, itaat etmek. Diğer şıklar: break (bozmak, çiğnemek), describe (tarif etmek, anlatmak), design (tasarlamak).

25

Cemre walked to a neighbour's house yesterday. She helped carry some shopping and spoke politely. She usually considers other people's needs. Her actions showed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) kindness

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre walked to a neighbour's house yesterday. She helped carry some shopping and spoke politely. She usually considers other people's needs.” Bu tarif “kindness” kelimesine uyar; kindness = nezaket, iyilik. Diğer şıklar: fear (korku), bias (önyargı), anger (öfke).
